reviews.x: I've been a makeup artist for over 30 years and have always been a fan of a dense foam sponge. My favorite one has an antibacterial strip inside. I am honestly not sure if I am ready to ditch the sponge, but using this silicone sponge is at least an interesting adventure. It's squishy and yet dense and when using, the makeup just slides almost like magic. The makeup finish is smooth and there is no residue left on the sponge to speak of. It all stays on the face. I absolutely love this makeup sponge. It really is as amazing as everyone says it is. It doesn't absorb makeup like a sponge or a brush does. And it's super simple to clean all you do is rinse it off with warm water. It takes some getting used to though to learn how to blend with it so it's not streaky but once you get the hang of it, it looks flawless! ❤

reviews.t: It does not blend easily and it has rough edges that makes it uncomfortable ...
reviews.x: This product is absolutely not what I had imagined.  It does not blend easily and it has rough edges that makes it uncomfortable to use on your face, particularly the eye area.  Not a fan of this product.
Was nervous to buy it not knowing anyone who uses it, but I love it. Blends well if used correctly. My favorite part is being able to clean it and have a clean start every time.

Claims to be Silisponge. Do not let this fool you like it did me. This is not the original Silisponge. I'm not sure how this company has gotten away with using this name since it is not their product. However, this is a silicone beauty sponge.  Much smaller than I thought it would be.

reviews.t: Did not like this method of application at all
reviews.x: Did not like this method of application at all. Felt like using a spatula to put on makeup. Difficult to even out coverage. After 5 minutes it was in the trash.

reviews.t: Not a good product. The makeup goes on like a putty ...
reviews.x: Not a good product.  The makeup goes on like a putty knife and does not blend in at ALL using the "sponge"  My face was covered in uneven streaks even after trying to blend for more than 3 minutes.  I would not recommend this product at all. Back to basic sponges and brushes for me.
So it came in the mall had rough edges smelled really bad and didn't really blend anything. Have better luck with my fingers.

The product is deserving of zero stars. Unfortunately that's not an option. This is not a ponge, its a plastic blob. All it does is smear foundation around your face. It does not blend cream foundations, or smooth it. It only smears cream foundations around your face. Looks horrible. No thanks,  going back to sponges.  Follow up- Someone asked if this would work with powdered foundations....first of all that's a dumb question...this thing is plastic. Second- no, this product won't work with powd

I hate this thing!! I thought it would be better as it doesn't waste product but it's impossible to get a smooth look with it. It's nothing like I expected. It smears the product and leaves weird marks in the makeup. Takes FOREVER to even "somewhat" blend. Ugh...Instant buyers remorse. Don't buy the hype.

reviews.t: I'm sticking with my regular beauty blending sponge
reviews.x: You end up applying more foundation and caking foundation on. It doesnt at all blend as well as a sponge. I ended up using a sponge because I was actually saving foundation because I wasn't needing to use as much. A regular beauty blender works best in my opinion.

I really wish I didn't fall for every beauty gimmick that appears and I should have skipped this one!  While the product itself is well made, it just doesn't deliver a flawless application like a sponge or brush.  Seems to just smear the foundation and leaves it looking streaky...I end up having to blend with a sponge anyway.  Seemed to work a bit better for concealer on my skin.  This is definitely not a replacement for your favorite sponge blender or foundation brush.  The only real pro is tha

reviews.t: I don't usually like to write a review where I strongly dislike something
reviews.x: I don't usually like to write a review where I strongly dislike something. This product doesn't blend very well at all. If you look for a blender that doesn't absorb the product... well, there is no such thing. Just use your fingers if you don't want to use a sponge. They don't waste product and blend way better.

As a makeup guru I understand this is a knock off from the original, however, I felt this applicator was sloppy and didn't blend as well as a beauty blender or foundation brush...You did however use much less product
This doesn't really work to blend out makeup. I now just use it to spread foundation onto the skin and then use a beauty blender or real techniques sponge from there
Not very good at blending. Maybe I don't know what I am doing with it, but I could not get it to work well.
I love it! It's so much better than a brush or sponge. So easy to clean as well!
Save your money. Not worth it. Back to sponges for me.
It just smears the makeup around, doesn't blend it.

reviews.t: Helpful but not a game changer
reviews.x: I tried this out knowing it was a little gimmicky. It does a fantastic job of getting product on the face and spreading it around with practically zero waste. However, as noted in other reviews I have read, it does a terribly job of blending out foundation, etc.  I use this to  put the foundation on my face and then use a blending sponge or round brush to blend my product out. reviews.t: Ok I like this but have mixed emotions
reviews.x: Ok I like this but have mixed emotions, I tried on my hand first and it blended very well, but my face and hand are way different. It takes a lot of extra dabbing to get it to blend so I put my foundation on and if there is a spot I cant blend usually around my eyes ill blend that area with my sponge. So im still saving a lot more on my foundation, which I usually use way to much, but it does take a lot more work. with this I use a pump and a half and with my sponge alone about four pumps of fou

reviews.t: I like it, Not seemless though.
reviews.x: Overall I like this product. It saves a lot of makeup, its durable, compact, and easy to clean. It is way more sanitary than other forms of makeup application. It is not the best for blending makeup. If you are trying to blend with this it will take a lot more work because its purpose not a blender, its an applicator. I dont like the protruding seem on this application I wish it was completely smooth all the way around. It is not "seemless" but I will keep it and it will last me a very l

It looks awesome in every instagram video....that's about it! This blender does not work any better than the beauty blender sponge that I've been using for years. The silicone sponge is so oddly shaped; you really don't know how to hold it from the get go, the blending of your foundation does not happen. Its almost as if your spreading the foundation on your face; it just does not sit well on your face...Its unfortunate, I regret paying the 3.99 for this.

reviews.t: As PT Barnum says "There's a sucker born every minute"
reviews.x: I was so excited to try this all new alternative to the beauty blender. I purchased two, one for myself and one for my daughter who's into makeup. Arrived on time but that's the ONLY positive about it. I fell for this scheme---It does NOT do what all the hype claims.  Foundation is applied very streaky--NO smooth coverage. Terrible product. Truly a disappointment.  I do not recommend wasting your money.

Ok, everyone is into this thing lately, and I'll admit I'm one of the people who couldn't resist trying it out. It definitely saves on makeup. It cleans up SO easy (thank goodness), although it does tend to gather foundation in the seam. Doesn't blend super well, but I've resorted to using this to spread my foundation, to use less, and use a regular foundation brush to blend it. Still pretty nifty.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it does not blend makeup well, leaving streaks or smearing foundation.
Some reviewers praise that it doesn't absorb or waste makeup product.
Several reviewers note it is easy to clean and gives a clean start each time.
Some reviewers mention rough edges that make it uncomfortable to use.
A few reviewers say it takes practice or getting used to before it works.
